description: Find creatures and NPCs by name (or creature id, or display id) in the local game files, with the model each one uses. Opens the game storage, so the first call takes about 40 seconds. Use the id with wow_creature_export.

flavor.description: Which installed client to read: mainline (retail), forever, classic or vanilla. Defaults to the first install found.

query.description: Creature name fragment, creature id or display id.
